Operator field corrected from blank to VISA based on the facility own name (source data left operator blank). Reused operator-level research from twoai_dc_operators row: VISA.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Visa Inc. is the global payments technology company headquartered in San Francisco, California. Visas own published materials describe a dual data center architecture for its core VisaNet payment processing network, with primary facilities in the Denver, Colorado area, sometimes described as Highlands Ranch or Central US, and in the Ashburn, Virginia area, described as Eastern US, designed to provide geographic redundancy for global transaction processing. The facility linked to this operator record, however, is located in Vernon Hills, Illinois, a Chicago suburb, and this research did not find that location corroborated by Visas own site or by Wikipedia. The only references found for a Vernon Hills data center address were an Illinois State Fire Marshal underground storage tank registry entry and a business directory listing showing the address associated with AT&T rather than Visa specifically, both of which are lower tier, lead level sources rather than confirmation that Visa operates a production data center at that address. Because Visas own documented architecture centers on the Denver and Ashburn facilities, this Vernon Hills record should be treated with caution and reviewed during the facility level research phase to confirm whether it is a genuine Visa facility, a misattributed AT&T or other carrier facility, or a smaller regional office rather than a data center. This specific facility, recorded in this registry as VISA Data Center in Ashburn, VA, was not individually named in the operator-level research above; its operator field was blank in the source data and is corrected here to VISA based on the facility own name, which unambiguously identifies its operator brand. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
